bindings.label: A 51-year-old man presented with a 6-year history of chronic cough

Cough was productive with an egg cup full of sputum daily, present day and night, associated with numerous triggers, rated 9/10 in severity, occurred largely in bouts often with retching and dizziness, and worsened in severity over the previous 2 years; he denied haemoptysis or breathlessness and weight was stable
Past medical history included a 15-year history of ulcerative colitis, initially managed medically, with subsequent total colectomy in 2017 and re-anastomosis in 2018
He was an ex-smoker who quit in 1999, with a 5 pack-years smoking history, and worked in construction with occasional exposure to spray paints
Physical examination showed BMI 25 kg·m−2, no clubbing, and unremarkable chest examination
Spirometry shows FEV1 3.89 L (111% predicted), FVC 5.74 L (131% predicted), FEV1/FVC 0.67, and normal TLCO/KCO
Capsaicin cough reflex sensitivity was not performed
Methacholine bronchial challenge was not performed
Laryngopharyngeal reflux and nasal examination data were not obtained
Cough hypersensitivity with cough-variant asthma component
Cough hypersensitivity with laryngopharyngeal reflux component
Cough hypersensitivity with upper airway cough syndrome component
